questions.q: Fit a 10-minute Qur'an slot into this sample exam day: Fajr 05:10, revision 08:00 to 12:00, exam 13:30.
questions.a: After Fajr, 05:15 to 05:25, before morning revision.

questions.a: A plan with daily slot, rota, Friday Al-Kahf, weekly check and a post-16 goal.

questions.q: Extend: write a short du'a (in English or Arabic) asking Allah to keep the Qur'an in your heart.
The best time for a short daily Qur'an slot is often ...
questions.a: A) after Fajr. Many find after Fajr the most consistent time.
a fixed time and a partner

questions.q: Think again: When school ends, who will check your hifdh? What will keep you going?
questions.a: A local teacher or masjid circle, a friend to recite with, and our own intention and du'a.
